messages:
acme_onboarding: hey @anna_cs — our trial credits dropped to 0 in the middle of a load test during the outage window. we were mid-load and started seeing 429s. can someone escalate for an emergency extension? ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/12345
anna_cs: sorry about that — can you share the account/org id and the approx time range of the test? i'll pull the dashboard and logs.
acme_onboarding: acct/org: org_0xACME. load test kicked off ~2024-11-18 16:40 UTC, errors from ~16:42–16:52. dashboard showed ~30% trial credits remaining before the outage.
infra-bot: Incident INC-20241118: routing/edge degradation in us-west causing elevated 429/502s for ~10m. full postmortem: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-20241118
luis_support: thanks for the details @acme_onboarding. policy: trial credits normally expire automatically at end of term, but we do manual grants when platform incidents cause premature exhaustion. i'll loop in billing ops.
devon_billing: please paste the billing/org id here and the approximate token count you expected to have left. i'll verify credit history and eligibility for a manual grant.
acme_onboarding: org_0xACME — expected ~125k tokens remaining per dashboard. our runner retried until we saw the 429s. example curl snippet we captured: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: abcd-1234
```
sophie_ops: we can request a one-time emergency restore. @devon_billing can you confirm if a pro-rated extension (tokens equivalent to outage window) is allowed?
devon_billing: given incident evidence and timing, we can offer a one-time 48-hour extension equivalent to 150k tokens. need CS approval + customer confirmation to proceed.
anna_cs: @acme_onboarding — do you confirm you want the 48h / 150k token extension? reply with `yes` and i'll trigger the manual grant.
acme_onboarding: yes please — that would be perfect, thanks :pray:
anna_cs: on it, granting now... :gear:
infra-bot: Manual credit grant executed: +150000 tokens to org_0xACME. Grant ID: grant_7890. Expires: 2024-11-20T16:42:00Z.
acme_onboarding: confirmed — i see the balance updated in the dashboard. quick question: will this change our billing or subscription commitments? we'll likely upgrade soon.
devon_billing: this is a one-time goodwill grant because of the incident. it does not alter billing commitments. when you upgrade we can help size Dedicated capacity to avoid throttle-related failures.
acme_onboarding: :thumbsup: closing the ticket on our side, appreciate the fast turnaround!
